title: China’s economy showing signs that slowdown may be extending

paragraphs.en: China’s economy is showing signs of extending a slowdown with a slump in industrial output and retail sales in July, adding to pressure on Beijing to intervene with measures to support activity.
paragraphs.zh: 中国经济出现放缓持续扩大的迹象：7月工业增加值和零售额双双下滑，这加大了北京方面出台措施支持经济活动的压力。

paragraphs.en: After the world’s second largest economy posted one of its lowest quarterly growth readings on record in the three months to June, the latest figures suggest it continued to falter in July.
paragraphs.zh: 在全球第二大经济体截至6月的三个月里录得有记录以来最低的季度增速之一后，最新数据表明其经济在7月继续步履蹒跚。

paragraphs.en: Factory output grew 4.5% from a year earlier last month, compared with 5.3% in June, official figures from the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) showed on Monday, missing a Reuters poll forecast for 4.8% growth.
paragraphs.zh: 中国国家统计局（NBS）周一公布的官方数据显示，上月规模以上工业增加值同比增长4.5%，低于6月的5.3%，也未达到路透调查预测的4.8%增速。

paragraphs.en: Related: Leading economies’ borrowing costs hit highest since 2008 crisis
paragraphs.zh: 相关阅读：主要经济体的借款成本升至2008年危机以来最高水平

paragraphs.en: Separate figures showed retail sales grew 0.6%, a slowdown from a 1% rise in June despite summer holiday tourism spending. Forecasters had predicted 1.5%.
paragraphs.zh: 另一项数据显示，尽管暑假旅游消费旺盛，零售额仍仅增长0.6%，较6月的1%增速有所放缓。此前预测机构预计增长1.5%。

paragraphs.en: The NBS said extreme weather, including high temperatures and heavy rainfall, had disrupted market supply and demand.
paragraphs.zh: 国家统计局表示，高温和强降雨等极端天气扰乱了市场供需。

paragraphs.en: The latest snapshot, however is likely to increase pressure on policymakers to accelerate plans for tax and spending measures to support activity.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这一最新数据很可能会加大政策制定者加快推出税收和支出措施以支持经济活动的压力。

paragraphs.en: China’s premier, Li Qiang, suggested on Monday that efforts to bolster overseas demand for goods could be used to make up for weak domestic demand.
paragraphs.zh: 中国国务院总理李强周一暗示，可以加大提振海外商品需求的努力，以弥补国内需求疲软。
